description: Qwen3-4B artifacts for the RK1828 PCIe NPU (RKNN3/RKLLM3 V1.0.4 toolchain). The four files are a MATCHED SET from one export — a mismatched .rknn/.weight pair will not load, so never mix versions or sources.

verified_runtime.note: 8192 loaded first try with no MODEL_SETUP failure. max_context is a RUNTIME parameter, not compiled into the .rknn — 2048 -> 8192 needed no re-export. 16384 is estimated at ~92% of the EP and is UNVERIFIED.

files.name: Qwen3-4B.embed.bin
files.role: embedding table (mmapped on the HOST, does not consume EP memory)
